plugins.displayName: Personal toolkit with custom skills for Anton

Builds game-ready 3D models in Blender from reference images, split into parts that builder agents work out in parallel to measured gates, with a fresh-eyes reviewer against the reference, and bakes layered materials checked against the reference
Finds real motion references for owner approval, measures the chosen video and transfers the movement to a rigged 3D character in the game engine animation stand

Personal development loop in the Obsidian vault: daily diary (dnevnik), ideas and goals (idea), weekly/monthly/yearly reviews with checked advice that also keep the owner's portrait, goals and finances current (itogi), and film curation (film)

Creates, extends, and fixes plugins in the anton-toolkit-marketplace via task-centric interviews. `create-plugin` scaffolds a new plugin, `extend-plugin` adds to an existing one, and `improve-plugin` applies reactive point fixes after an in-session incident.
Designs personal development projects as short reference documentation in the Obsidian vault: concept, architecture hub with diagrams, area notes and phase outlines
Helps the teacher run a vibe-coding course: an interview-driven roadmap builder and a beginner-friendly per-lesson writer that save Russian Markdown files into the Obsidian vault's Курс/ folder

Toolkit for running a Russian-language IT/vibe-coding YouTube channel: own-channel analytics, competitor analysis, idea generation, content planning, script writing, editing sheets, recorded-voice video assembly, motion clips, SEO, thumbnails, and on-channel lead generation
